_about: Fixed renderings of the site's own vocabulary, per locale. The draft script hands these to the model with every batch, and a reviewer changes a term here rather than in a hundred strings. A term with no entry for a locale is the model's call. Keep the note in English: it is the reviewer's brief.

fairminter.note: Counterparty's on-chain mint contract. A proper noun on this site. ZH: BRC-20 readers know 公平铸造 (fair mint). The Counterparty contract is the 合约. ES: proper noun, lowercase, glossed once as el contrato de acuñación justa. KO: loanword, as the BRC-20 community writes 페어민트.

mint.note: Verb and noun: paying XCP into a fairminter for tokens. ZH: UniSat and the BRC-20 community write Mint as 铸造. ES: acuñar is UniSat's word; the community also says mintear — use acuñar in UI and prose. KO: 민팅 (noun and 민팅하다), the NFT/inscription word; never 발행 (issuance).

launch.note: One XCP-69 token launch, from announcement to pool. ZH: pump.fun Chinese idiom: a token is 发射 (launched); a launchpad is 发射台. Never 发行 (issuance) or 启动. Chinese pump.fun coverage says 发射 and 发币 interchangeably and frames phases as 内盘 (bonding curve) → 外盘 (DEX); Traditional coverage uses the same characters (發射, 畢業). ES: lanzamiento (noun), lanzar (verb); a launchpad is plataforma de lanzamiento. KO: 런칭 for the act, 런치패드 for the platform, as pump.fun Korean coverage writes; never 발행 or 상장.

graduated.note: The launch sold out and its pool opened. pump.fun's sense of the word. ZH: pump.fun 内盘→外盘 vocabulary: 毕业 is the word the Chinese memecoin community uses. ES: pump.fun Spanish coverage says graduarse / graduación. KO: 졸업, attested in crypto.com and BTCC Korean pump.fun explainers.

refunded.note: The launch missed its soft cap and everyone was repaid. KO: 환불 for the refund, 환불됨 as the phase chip.

scheduled.note: Announced, not yet open for minting. ZH: Announced on-chain, minting not open yet.

upcoming.note: Chip on a scheduled launch's card.

soft cap.note: The 69M-token sale target. Keep the loanword. Both communities keep the English term.

pool.note: The TOKEN/XCP AMM pool. ZH: 池 alone in tight labels. Uniswap zh-TW uses 資金池, but 流動性池 is clearer for an AMM. ES: Uniswap keeps pool; pool de liquidez when spelled out. KO: 풀 (Uniswap), 유동성 풀 spelled out.

LP burned.note: The pool's LP tokens were destroyed, so liquidity is locked forever. ZH: 销毁 is the one Chinese word for burn; there is no バーン/焼却 split.

market cap.note: ES: capitalización de mercado in prose, cap. de mercado on a tight label. JA: 時価総額 confirmed by CoinMarketCap Japan and Japanese X posts.

holders.note: Katakana, as the Japanese crypto community writes it; 保有者 is the formal word exchanges use. ZH: UniSat and CMC China. Not 持币地址. MONAPARTY: Monacard writes 所有者, Monapalette 保有者, blogs ホルダー; ホルダー kept for the memecoin register. ES: the community says holders; Uniswap's titulares and UniSat's poseedores read like a bank. KO: 홀더 is what Korean crypto Twitter and Upbit communities say; Uniswap's 보유자 is the formal word.

supply.note: MONAPARTY 2026-09-07: the Monaparty wiki writes 発行量ロック for locking supply and Monapalette shows 現在の発行数; 供給量 appears in no Japanese Counterparty source. Circulating supply stays 流通供給量 (CoinGecko Japan). Both wallets: suministro total / 총 공급량.

volume.note: The stock-market word, and what CoinMarketCap Japan uses. Zaif writes 取引高 in prose; keep 出来高 everywhere on this site. ZH: Uniswap and CMC China. UniSat writes 成交量; keep 交易量 everywhere here. JA: CoinMarketCap Japan writes 出来高 (24時間); confirms 出来高 over Zaif’s 取引高.

since mint.note: Return measured from the mint price. ZH: Return measured from the mint price.

all-time.note: The whole life of the market, as a window label beside 24h. ZH: CMC/Uniswap range label. As the window beside 24h on a card, 全期 fits where space is tight. Uniswap's range label in both languages. On a card beside 24H: Total / 전체.

performance.note: Return as a percentage, the way CMC labels it.

swap.note: Uniswap and UniSat both. ES: UniSat's intercambiar; Uniswap says cambiar; the noun stays swap in casual Spanish. KO: 스왑.

limit.note: Limit orders on Counterparty's order book (the nav label). KO: 지정가 (limit) vs 시장가 (market), Korean exchange vocabulary.

dispense.note: The nav label for buying XCP from Counterparty dispensers; same word as dispenser in every locale. ES: dispensador is an ordinary Spanish word for exactly this machine. KO: 자판기, the everyday vending-machine word, on Dan's rule that a dispenser is a vending machine.

dispenser.note: DECIDED 2026-09-07: a dispenser is a vending machine. Attested in Japanese by the Monaparty (Japanese Counterparty fork) community: a note.com explainer titled 「Monaparty アセットの自動販売機」 says Dispenser に当たる和訳はいくつかありますが、このメッセージの働きに最も近いのは「自動販売機」です, and writes Dispenser in Latin in the body; ディスペンサー was our own loanword with no community use, so 自販機 (the everyday short form) replaces it. Chinese has no attested community term: press wrote 分配器 once (Sohu), our draft said 分发器, and 售货机 / 販賣機 / 售賣機 are the regional vending-machine words. The verb sense, send BTC and receive XCP, is what the word has to carry.

docs.note: Taiwan and Hong Kong say 文件 for documentation; the mainland says 文档.

rewards.note: The XCP Rewards programme for minters.

mempool.note: Taiwan says 記憶體 for memory; Hong Kong and the mainland say 内存. MONAPARTY writes mempool in Latin; the wiki says mempool上にある未承認トランザクション. Katakana kept.

connect.note: Connect a wallet. ZH: Connect a wallet: 连接钱包 on Uniswap and UniSat. OpenCC turns 连接 into 連線 for Taiwan, which is the network sense; keep 連接. ES: conectar billetera (billetera, UniSat's word for Latin America; never cartera). KO: 지갑 연결 (Uniswap).

all-time high.note: Keep the Latin abbreviation the community uses; CMC Japan writes 過去最高値. ZH: CMC China writes 历史最高价; ATH is also understood but the Chinese is the norm. KO: Upbit and Korean press write 역대 최고가; ATH is understood too.

send.note: Moving an asset between addresses. Zaif and the wider community say 送金; 送付 is for documents. MONAPARTY: 送金 in prose; Mpurse's button says 送信. KO: 전송 (Uniswap/UniSat), not 송금 which implies fiat.

miner fee.ja: トランザクション手数料
miner fee.note: The Bitcoin fee. Zaif calls its withdrawal network fee 送金手数料, but on this site the fee goes to miners, not to us. ZH: UniSat writes 网络费用 for the network fee; on this site the fee goes to miners, so 矿工费. MONAPARTY: both Japanese Counterparty wallets, Mpurse and Monapalette, label it トランザクション手数料; replaces マイナー手数料. ES: comisión (not tarifa) is how Spanish Bitcoin users say fee; UniSat writes tarifa de red. KO: 채굴 수수료 for the Bitcoin miner fee; 네트워크 수수료 is the generic word.

burn.note: DECIDED 2026-09-07: Japanese press heads the term as バーン（焼却）everywhere (CoinPost glossary, Coincheck, CoinDesk Japan), so バーン is used for every burn on the site including LP バーン済み; 破棄 is kept only for Counterparty’s destroy message, where consensus destroys escrowed supply after a refund. Chinese is 销毁 in every sense; OpenCC emits 銷燬 and the derivation script restores 銷毀. MONAPARTY: バーン, Burn and 焼く in community text; confirms バーン. ES: quemar / quemado (UniSat). KO: 소각, the one Korean word for burn.

base currency.note: XCP as Counterparty’s native currency. Zaif’s own wording in its asset guide.

transaction.note: A Bitcoin transaction. A fill or trade is 成交, so the two never share a word in one sentence. KO: 트랜잭션 for an on-chain transaction (Uniswap); 거래 is a trade. ES: transacción vs operación for a trade.

fill.note: KO: 체결, the Korean exchange word for a fill. ES: ejecutada / ejecución.

order book.note: MONAPARTY: 板, 注文, 買い/売り, 約定 are the words in Monapalette, the Spotlight DEX guide and Ask Mona; matches.

slippage.note: ES: deslizamiento (Uniswap and UniSat). KO: 슬리피지 is the common spelling; Uniswap's 슬리페이지 is rarer.

escrow.note: XCP held by the protocol until the launch resolves. ES: en custodia del protocolo; escrow alone is not Spanish.

lot.note: A 1,000-token lot: 一份 1,000 枚. ES: lote de 1,000 tokens. KO: 1,000토큰 단위.

dumper.note: An address that sold within blocks of graduation. Both communities use the English word; ES los dumpers, KO 덤퍼. The verb: dumpear / 덤핑.

rug pull.note: The community word; 拉地毯 is a calque nobody uses. Kept in English in both; ES may gloss as estafa de salida once.

Bitcoin.note: BTC stays BTC as a ticker. ES keeps Bitcoin; KO writes 비트코인 in prose, BTC as ticker.

Counterparty.note: Always Latin. Chinese press writes Counterparty 协议; never 交易对手 (the finance word, seen in one machine-translated Sohu piece). 合约币 was the 2014 Chinese press name for XCP (8BTC) and is not used today.

proof of burn.note: Chinese press: 销毁证明 (PoB). Japanese press: プルーフ・オブ・バーン.

confirmed.note: MONAPARTY: confirmations are 承認 (承認数, ゼロ承認 in Monapalette; 未承認トランザクション on the wiki). 確定 is kept only for a launch resolving at its deadline and for realized P&L. KO: 확인 / 컨펌 for confirmations; 컨펌 is community slang, 확인 is the wallet word.

description.note: MONAPARTY: the asset description field is 説明文 (Monapalette トークンの説明文を変更する, wiki).

coin (as a traded name).note: JAPANESE X 2026-09: traders call each coin a 銘柄 (コミュニティが強い銘柄); used for graduated coins on the stats page (卒業銘柄). コイン stays where the English explains what a coin is.

surge.note: JAPANESE X: 高騰 for a price surge (XCP の高騰); 火を吹く and 億る are slang, not for UI.
